description: This file defines a utility class 'ThreadRAII' that manages a std::thread object, ensuring proper join on destruction, with exception handling. It is part of the 'Utils' namespace and includes logging for error handling.

classes.name: ThreadRAII
classes.description: A RAII wrapper for std::thread that ensures thread is joined upon destruction, with support for move semantics.

methods.name: ThreadRAII(std::thread&& t)
methods.description: Constructor that takes an rvalue reference to a std::thread and takes ownership.

methods.name: ~ThreadRAII()
methods.description: Destructor that joins the thread if joinable, with exception handling.

methods.name: get()
methods.description: Returns a reference to the managed std::thread.
